info.title: Tracecart API
info.description: REST API for the Tracecart store, customer accounts, back office, Seller Center and Partner portal. Each operation's x-tracecart-access says who may call it: public, session, account, a permission, or partner:<scope> for a partner's API key.

bearerAuth.description: A Clerk session token for a user linked to a Tracecart account.

partnerKey.description: A partner's API key (docs/partner-api.md): one company, chosen scopes, revocable.

kind.description: null: this product has nothing to fit.

status.description: verified: a listed fitment matches and rests on evidence; potential: one matches, but only the seller says so, or the customer left something out; insufficient: nothing listed matches (which isn't "doesn't fit").

missing.description: What to add to know more, in the order to ask.

sku.description: The variant the answer is for.

days.description: Days until it's handed over (in stock, seller), or until it leaves the supplier (abroad). Not a delivery date: that comes with the delivery promise at checkout.

sku.description: The shown offer's variant (the first variant when there is no price): what a wish list keeps.

price.description: null: no confirmed price in this currency; the store offers to quote it (ADR-078).

dealEndsAt.description: When the shown price is a deal (ADR-070): when it ends.

allOf.description: null when there is no price.

verified.description: A person approved the seller's company and documents (ADR-050).

seller.description: Who sells the shown offer; null: Tracecart, or no offer yet.

rating.description: From approved reviews by customers who received it; null: none yet.

correctedQuery.description: What was searched instead, when the words as typed found nothing.

phrase.description: The words of the query it was read from.

amountMinor.description: priceMax, priceMin: in minor units of `currency`.

value.description: brand: its slug; condition: REFURBISHED or USED; delivery: local.

removeQuery.description: The query without this phrase, to undo it.

interpreted.description: Filters read from the query's words (a price limit, a brand, a condition, in stock), applied unless the same filter was given as a parameter.

truncated.description: More products matched than are filtered and counted at once; the query should be narrowed.

dealEndsAt.description: When this price is a deal (ADR-070): when it ends.

seller.description: null: sold by Tracecart. verified: a person approved the seller (ADR-050).

fitments.description: What this variant is listed to fit, each with what it rests on (ADR-080).

fitmentKind.description: What it can fit, for "will it fit?" (ADR-080); null: nothing to check.

quoteOnly.description: No variant has a price in this currency: the product shows without one, and the store offers to quote it (ADR-078).

direction.description: from: this product FITS/CHARGES… the ones listed; to: the ones listed FIT/CHARGE… this product.

verified.description: true: each link rests on a manufacturer document, an OEM cross-reference or a staff test; false: only "may fit" (ADR-080).

permissions.description: Every permission the user's roles give, sorted.

roles.description: The keys of the user's roles, once each.

orderProgress.description: Shipped, delivered, delays and new delivery windows. Collection codes, failed attempts and everything about money are always sent.

marketing.description: Deals and news, only with consent.

offerId.description: Which of the SKU's Tracecart offers, when it has more than one.

rate.description: Units of `currency` for one unit of `base`.

aloneCostMinor.description: What the carrier would charge for each alone
